name: Longbridge
description: Longbridge lets agents read quotes, market data, positions, and account balances for the signed-in Longbridge account. Each user signs in to their own Longbridge account through the browser.

prompts.text: Summarize my positions and their profit and loss today.
Show the latest quote and trading volume for TSLA.
Compare the price change this month for AAPL, MSFT, and NVDA.

apps.name: Longbridge
apps.description: Quotes, market data, positions, and balances, over Longbridge's MCP server with browser sign-in.
